result.description: A fictional encrypted portable storage device built for archival teams, field researchers, and media libraries. The Orion Quill combines a 4 TB solid-state drive with tamper-resistant hardware encryption, a write-protect mode, and a shock-absorbing aluminum shell for travel-ready data retention. It uses USB-C connectivity, supports cross-platform access, and is positioned for secure document transport rather than creative workstation acceleration or general-purpose desktop expansion.
result.title: Orion Quill 4TB Nebula Vault
